mapper.select: SELECT goal_id AS goalId, user_id AS userId, name AS name, target_amount AS targetAmount, current_amount AS currentAmount FROM goals WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}

SELECT e.emotion_id AS emotionId, e.name AS name, e.color AS color, SUM(t.amount) AS monthlyAmount FROM transactions t JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.occurred_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.occurred_at) = #{month} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY e.emotion_id, e.name, e.color ORDER BY monthlyAmount DESC LIMIT 1
